value: {"title":"IMF Staff Report: Argentina Eighth Review Under the Extended Fund Facility","publicationDate":"2024-06-01","year":"2024","summary":"This document package details the International Monetary Fund's (IMF) Eighth Review of Argentina's Extended Fund Facility (EFF) arrangement, dated June 2024, following discussions held in April-May 2024. All end-March 2024 quantitative performance criteria were met, and waivers for exchange restrictions were approved.\n\nThe report highlights significant progress in Argentina's stabilization plan, driven by decisive policy actions, including fiscal and external surpluses, reserve accumulation, and reduced sovereign spreads. The document also addresses the macroeconomic outlook, projecting a fall in monthly inflation, stable reserves, and sustained fiscal/external surpluses, while acknowledging elevated risks. It details supply-side policies aimed at correcting price misalignments and fostering a market-oriented economy through deregulation and eased FX restrictions.
